mapper.select: SELECT x.*, m.code AS substitute_code, m.name AS substitute_name, m.spec, m.unit, m.serial_enabled, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(st.qty), 0) FROM wms_stock st WHERE st.material_id = x.substitute_id) AS on_hand_qty FROM mes_material_substitute x JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = x.substitute_id WHERE x.material_id IN #{id} ORDER BY x.material_id, x.priority, m.code
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO mes_material_substitute (material_id, substitute_id, ratio, priority, remark, create_time, update_time) VALUES
(#{i.materialId}, #{i.substituteId}, #{i.ratio}, #{i.priority}, #{i.remark}, NOW(), NOW())
